image_description: A low-angle shot of a large, ornate wooden pipe organ installed in an architectural setting. The organ features a central facade of tall, vertical metallic pipes flanked by shorter pipes on either side, all housed within a decorative wooden case with carved details. Below the pipes is a wooden structure that appears to be part of the console or casing, though the keyboards and pedalboard are not clearly visible due to the angle and cropping. Dark blue curtains frame the sides of the instrument.
